title:
This epic is responsible for managing the loading state and triggering an API call to refresh the inventory statistics for the "Reliability.SparePartsGrid".
It listens for actions and performs the following operations:

1. Displays a loading spinner (`Reliability.SparePartsGridSpinner`) while the data is being fetched.
2. Makes an AJAX request to the `InventorySeries.refreshStats` API to refresh the inventory statistics.
3. After the API call completes, it triggers a request for the updated data for the "Reliability.SparePartsGrid".
4. Hides the loading spinner once the data request has been successfully initiated.
Additionally, the epic dispatches actions to update the UI with the fetched data, ensuring the grid is refreshed with the latest statistics.
name: RefreshStatsForPartsGridEpic
